policy_title: Tackle youth crime with High Intensity Training Camps
stated: Reform UK will tackle youth crime by reopening High Intensity Training Camps for young offenders to teach basic education, teamwork, and values.

source.quote: Tackle Youth Crime Reopen High Intensity Training Camps for young offenders to teach basic education, teamwork and values.

bearing_set.reason: Directly targets youth crime and young offenders, with a stated aim of reducing reoffending — earns a real verdict on safety, justice, and crime rates.
The camps explicitly include basic education as a component, bearing materially on education access and opportunity for young offenders.

membership_note: O5 and O7 are both genuine bearings: the policy targets crime reduction (O5) and explicitly includes education (O7). O10 is not included because the camps operate within the existing sentencing framework — the liberty curtailment is inherent to the sentence already imposed, not an additional coercive power. O15 (cohesion) and O14 (inequality) would only be affected via long causal chains too indirect to clear the non-negligible bar.
